create_cloudfront_signer: create a CloudFrontSigner instance with a key pair id, PEM private key, and expiration seconds
sign_cloudfront_url: sign a CloudFront URL so it is valid until the configured expiration time
get_cloudfront_signer: get a CloudFrontSigner from a CloudFrontConfig, returning None if credentials are missing
validate_private_key: validate that a PEM private key is a valid RSA key for CloudFront URL signing
generate_presigned_url: generate a presigned CloudFront URL with a canned policy and specific expiry datetime
